basis: Cortical malformations and pyramidal tract hypoplasia define neurologic disease; respiratory insufficiency is a defining feature. Akinesia alone does not establish muscle damage.
Malignant melanoma originating in skin; possible nodal metastasis does not establish another qualifying organ axis.
Adrenal aldosterone excess, hypokalemia and severe early-onset hypertension define the disease; cardiac hypertrophy and hemorrhage are occasional.
Severe intellectual disability, developmental delay, seizures and spasticity define a neurodevelopmental disorder; hypotonia alone does not establish muscle disease.
Congenital absence of nails and ectrodactyly define nail and skeletal limb abnormalities.
KCNB1-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; no evidence of a separate metabolic disorder or direct muscle damage.
Congenital ocular motor disorder with persistent nystagmus and reduced visual acuity; no independent brain disorder is established.
Definition specifies nonsyndromic sensorineural deafness, with possible vestibular dysfunction; historical Usher synonyms do not establish retinal disease.
Ectodermal dysplasia involves hair, nails and tooth enamel/shape; syndactyly defines the limb component.
Primary congenital microcephaly defines abnormal brain development; short stature alone does not establish skeletal or endocrine damage.
Deficiency of corneal limbal stem cells impairs ocular surface maintenance and vision; manifestations remain within the ocular axis.
Purely psychiatric psychotic disorder; no qualifying organ damage is intrinsic to the definition.
GPI-anchor biosynthesis disorder with seizures and callosal dysplasia in 2/2 patients. Chronic otitis and osteomyelitis are separate conditions; minor skin findings do not establish damage.
Peroxisomal metabolic disease with adrenal insufficiency and CNS demyelination/axonopathy. Visual, auditory and bladder deficits can reflect neural dysfunction without direct organ damage.
Femoral head osteonecrosis with cartilage destruction and muscle atrophy. Dentition abnormalities annotated 80-99% lack detail establishing direct dental damage.
Polyp arising in the rectum; no other organ involvement is intrinsic to the concept.
Cortical and other brain malformations define the disease; persistent strabismus in 9/9 and bilateral ptosis in 30-79% support ocular functional involvement.
Microcephaly and intellectual disability accompany severe hand/foot syndactyly. Short stature and the endocrine-growth parent do not establish endocrine gland dysfunction.
Axonal sensorimotor neuropathy; muscle atrophy in 80-99% and contractures in 30-79%; vocal cord paresis in 30-79% causes persistent laryngeal dysfunction.
Squamous carcinoma originates in nasal or paranasal sinus mucosa, included in the pulmonary airway axis.
Tumor originates in the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes; urinary-system ancestry does not establish urinary tract invasion or damage.
Deletion syndrome associated with neurodevelopmental impairment; absent definition and phenotype annotations limit confidence and preclude additional organ labels.
KIF1A neurodegenerative/axonal disease spectrum; optic nerve atrophy with visual impairment occurs in roughly 40-50%, with frequency varying by subtype.
Recessive titin-related skeletal myopathy. Cardiomyopathy varies substantially by subtype and is not established at >=30% across this umbrella; respiratory weakness is muscular.
Subcutaneous lipomas and limb hemihyperplasia define the syndrome; cerebral vascular malformations are annotated 30-79%. Embryonal malignancy is only a later risk.
